answer: A stake-weighted reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks by making each identity costly to create: an agent must lock collateral before its attestations carry weight, so a whisper of cheap fake accounts cannot outvote honest ones. Every claim leaves a crystal-clear, checkable trail, and peers downgrade identities whose signal of past behavior is inconsistent, so an attacker must fund and maintain many credible histories instead of spinning up free sockpuppets.
